title: ZeroTag
summary: Amiibo library and emulator for the CardputerZero with the NFC Cap
description:
ZeroTag turns the CardputerZero and its Cap CC1101 (ST25R3916) into an amiibo library and emulator.

- Library of your own 540-byte backups (put them in ~/amiibo), recognised automatically, with signature check.
- Catalogue of 954 characters: create blank, correctly signed amiibo.
- NTAG215 emulation, verified with a Flipper Zero and a Nintendo Switch 2. What the game writes is saved to the file (autosave), signatures stay valid.
- Optional UID rotation after each read, keeping the data.
- Text search (names, series, ids; accents ignored), favourites, recent list and a scan of your real figures.
- Optional online update (off by default): Settings > Online downloads the public amiiboapi.org list so newly announced amiibo appear marked NEW or SOON. Nothing about you or the device is sent.
- Famicom-style interface in French, English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese, with in-app help (Fn+H).

Setup: copy your own key_retail.bin to ~/.zerotag/. After each boot the app offers to enable the Cap (it loads the SPI overlay with sudo: type your password on the keyboard, it is never stored); you can also run sudo /usr/lib/zerotag/cap-setup yourself. The app works fully offline. Amiibo thumbnails (artwork owned by Nintendo, from AmiiboAPI) are included for display only; your key_retail.bin is not.

Version 1.0 is a complete rewrite in Rust: statically linked, light on CPU and memory, with a demoscene manual in the settings.
